Hi Lena — thanks for the quick note.

We're evaluating ROI for Q4 events and want to move straight to Gold if the economics line up. A few clarifying asks before we sign:

- Confirm keynote panel slot timing (day 1 morning vs day 2 afternoon) and whether we can request a 20 min moderated demo slot as part of the panel.
- Stage logo placement: will the Gold backdrop include company logos in the center band or only on the lower scroller? We need prominent center-band placement for the keynote.
- Double booth logistics: confirmed 20x20 footprint and two full demo tables? Is electrical/internet included or billed as add-ons?
- Lead retrieval: will the app export be provided post-event (CSV) and is there an add-on for onsite badge-scan lead capture?

If you can send the Gold SOW and a revised invoice, I will route for final approval. I'm copying Vanessa (field events lead) and Tessa (marketing ops) to confirm logistics and creative.

Appreciate it —
Soojin Lee
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Hi Soojin,

Great — happy to proceed. Answers below and I've attached the updated Gold SOW and draft invoice.

- Keynote panel: Gold sponsors receive one panel slot on Day 1 (11:00–12:00). We can typically fit a 15–20 minute demo within the panel if pre-coordinated with the moderator.
- Stage logo placement: Gold receives center-band logo placement (1200x300 px region) and smaller lower scroller presence. We can confirm exact positioning after your creative submission.
- Double booth: 20x20 footprint with two demo tables included. Electrical (1x20A) and basic wired internet are included; higher-bandwidth or dedicated circuits are add-ons.
- Lead retrieval: mobile app export (CSV) is included post-event. Onsite badge-scan hardware is a paid add-on — I've listed pricing in the invoice.

I've attached: RWI_Gold_SOW_v2.pdf and Invoice_Draft.pdf. Once you confirm, I can push the contract to DocuSign.
